description: Add WebP as a supported image format in the default image options. This format should be available alongside existing image formats for users to select when working with images in the system. The implementation should ensure WebP is properly integrated as a standard option throughout the image handling workflow.
functional_requirements: Add WebP to the list of default image format options available in the UI
Update the database schema to include WebP as a valid image format option
Ensure the image processing system recognizes and handles WebP format appropriately
Maintain backward compatibility with existing image format selections
Update any relevant validation logic to accept WebP as a valid image format
